did: On the server's drift epic, every table now says how its rows live. A test fails if a kept record loses its guard, or if code deletes one outside the voice-note deletes you already ruled on. The nudge waker, the biggest file in the repo, is split into its stages, and a test stops any of them growing back. Dead code and a missing README on thirty-six crates are gone, with a check so a manifest can't name a file that isn't there. The clock clean-up was left alone because it reaches into the transcriber's files. Everything is on a branch waiting to be admitted.

calls.title: Which references may block an account's deletion (C958)
options: no reference points at a table scoped to one person, and a parent that isn't deleted with its child must never be deleted
neither end of a reference scoped to a person
calls.why: It holds for every reference on main today, including the one the cards-essay withdrawal added, and still keeps every account deletable.
calls.undo: Tighten the reference test to reject a scoped child too.

calls.title: How a split file is kept from growing back (C961)
options: one ceiling for every file in file_host
calls.why: Other busy files already exceed a repo-wide 500, so a scoped ceiling fails only what this split owns.

left: About 640 unneeded pub items to narrow, and dead code in the transcriber and game-week lanes, written on server#491.
The shared clock (server#483) reaches the transcriber's files, so it waits for that lane to settle.
The assurance ledger's three nudge proofs must be re-pointed in some-ui and merged as a pair with this branch.
